## What and why

## Scientific checklist
- [ ] Every new scientific claim has a PMID/DOI in the `evidence` table or code
- [ ] No numeric compatibility, success or efficacy claims
- [ ] Output says "hypothetical / computational", not "engineered"
- [ ] Unknowns are reported as unknown, not guessed

## Engineering checklist
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated
- [ ] `ruff check` and `pytest` pass locally
- [ ] Schema change? New migration file added (never edit an applied one)
